english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial verb for enjoying or favoring something, including mild romantic interest in a person.

exampleSentences.english: I like drinking iced lemon tea.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jam2 dung3 ling4 caa4

english.note: Use this as the everyday choice for liking someone or something, including the emphatic sense of really liking it.

exampleSentences.english: I really love drinking Hong Kong-style milk tea.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我真係鍾意食港式奶茶。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 zung1 ji3 sik6 gong2 sik1 naai5 caa4

english.note: Use this colloquial choice when “enjoy” means generally liking an activity or finding it pleasurable.

exampleSentences.english: I enjoy listening to music after work.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 fong3 gung1 hau6 teng1 go1

english.note: Use this when “rate” means to like or approve of something rather than assess it formally.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gei2 zung1 ji3 ni1 sau2 go1
